general_summary:
Miguel Barbosa + Associates is an innovative architecture and urban design office.
It has accomplished architectural works with extensive experience inthe arts, campus, and educational facilities, and residential work. Otherprojects include retail design, office design, public utilities, and masterplanning. With each project, the firm explores new ways to integrate anorganized idea with the programmatic and functional essence of abuilding.  Rather than imposing a style upon different sites and climates, orpursued irrespective of program, the unique character of a program and a sitebecomes the starting point for an architectural idea.
While anchoring each work in its specific site and circumstance, Miguel Barbosa Architects endeavors to obtain a deeper beginning in theexperience of time, space, light, and materials.  The phenomena of the space of a room, the sunlight entering through awindow, and the color and reflection of materials on a wall and floor, all haveintegral relationships.  The materials communicate through resonance and dissonance, just asinstruments in musical composition, producing thought and sense-provokingqualities in the experience of a place undefined.
Extending this approach with ecological innovation, Miguel Barbosa + Associates is recognized for the ability to shapespace and light with great contextual sensitivity and to catalyze the uniquequalities of each project to create a concept-driven design at multiple scales,from minimal dwellings to new hybrid models of urbanism.

general_summary: Master's in Architecture from the Faculty of Architecture of the University of Porto and the Technical School of Architecture of Barcelona (2004 - 2010). Collaborated with Architect Pedro Magalhães Basto in Porto during the academic journey and with Santiago Vives in Barcelona after completing the studies. Founder of Martina Architecture (2016), continues to this day as a designer, working both individually and occasionally in partnerships with other colleagues. The practice of everyday architecture is developed with the belief that recurrent travels to other cities enhance knowledge and become essential in finding solutions that are contemporary, daring, and capable. general_summary: Maxime Mangold is a young architect based in Lyon (France) and Lisbon (Portugal). Since 2019, he has been developing projects of different types at different scales. With the aim of simplicity and sustainability, the office conducts a reflection and specific support for each project. This results in a rational and fresh architectural language where each decision is taken transparently with the client for the benefit of the final object.

joão nuno macedo, arquitectos is a portuguese architecture studio, based in Braga. The practice positions itself between the architecture exercise and the contemporary realities of the user, throughout a negotiation process between the parts until reaching a final result. It´s our belief that more than proposing a finished design of a certain space, the architecture exercise is, fundamentally, to imbue space with the ability to adapt to the needs of the contemporary user with a clear sense of the character of each programmatic space, of its potentialities and care for a human harmonic scale.

“POSTO 9” develops works in the scope of architecture, urbanism, and construction supervision, operating in various national and international geographical areas, and having particular vocation to act as a privileged partner in the development of projects in Portuguese-speaking territory. The entrepreneurial strategy consists on the excellence of service rendering and on a close relationship with the clients, supporting their investments in the quest for maximum quality with an effective cost control. The programmatic and geographical diversity of the elaborated projects is supported by an action of coordination of multidisciplinary teams, where companies accredited in the different technical areas participate.
